hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/lib/*.mjs|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/tests/*.mjs|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/service-worker.js|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/content-script.js) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && node tests/run-tests.mjs ;; esac

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/manifest.json) node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/manifest.json','utf8'))" && echo "manifest.json: valid JSON" ;; esac
